intent: Bound product-read retries so a degraded cache cannot multiply database load during an incident.

constraints.statement: A product read MUST make at most two cache attempts before falling back to the database, and MUST NOT retry the database read inside one request.

evidence.note: Fixture read path with the retry budget constant; no network.
Executable fixture test; the structural check does not run it.
Escalation/alerting test is not written yet; completion must fail until it exists.

openQuestions: Is the budget per request or per product id under concurrent reads?
